translations.web: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
translations.bsb: While Peter was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
translations.kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
translations.asv: And while he said these things, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
